text:
Type: rectangular wooden dining table
Use: dining, working at a table; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: Scandinavian, mid-century modern, Japandi
Materials: ash veneer top with clear lacquer, solid wood legs
Colors: light natural ash, pale blond wood
Shape: thin top with soft rounded corners and beveled edge, four slender round tapered legs slightly splayed, fixed right under the top, light and open
Feel: airy, warm, calm, natural
Goes with: white walls, light wood or black chairs, woven textiles; Scandinavian or Japandi dining rooms

product.name: LISABO
product.description: Easy to assemble as each leg has only one fitting.
